e.summary: **Vergelijkdirect Insurance Transmission Client**（npm `@vergelijkdirect/insurance-transmission-client`）**是一个**发**布**在 **npm**、**而**仓**库**在 **Bitbucket** 的**保险**报**价**传**输**客**户端****——**逐字自述**为**「**Partner-facing JavaScript/TypeScript client for the Vergelijkdirect Insurance Transmission API**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 最新**版本逐字 **`1.3.73-VER-9344.0`****、**许可**逐字 **`ISC`****、**首次**发布 **2023-09-27****、**末次**修改 **2026-09-24****（**窗口内）**、**共 **61** 个**版本****、**维护**者 **7** 人**、**周**下载量**逐字 **236**（**2026-09-15 至 **2026-09-21）**；**⭐ 仓库**地址**逐字**为 **`bitbucket.org/vergelijkdirect/insurance-transmission-client`****；**⭐ **README** 实测 **12,982** 字符**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**软件**包**注册处**面（**npm）**」**——**⭐ 而**本条**同时**给**出**一**条**本**轮**最**有**用**的**路径**判**据**（**见 ⚠️⭐ 第 **③** 条）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① ⚠️⭐ 它**说明**「**包**注**册处**可以**绕**过**被**鉴权**挡**住**的**托管**面」**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**该**包**的 **`repository`** 字段**逐字**为 **`git+https://hennadii-kolesnyk@bitbucket.org/vergelijkdirect/insurance-transmission-client.git`****，**即**代码**托管**在 **Bitbucket****；**⭐ 而**第 **381** 轮**已**记**下 **Bitbucket** 的**全局**搜索**需**鉴权、**本**轮**仍**未**探**——**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**注**册处**（**npm／**PyPI）**会**暴**露**仓**库**地址」**，**故**要**找**某**个**被**搜**索引**挡**住**的**平台**上**的**保险**软件**，**可以**从**包**注册处**的 **`repository`** 与 **`homepage`** 字段**反**查**（**⭐ 本**轮**即**由**此**看**到 **Bitbucket** 上**的**实际**项目）**；**② **它**的**领域**动作**很**具体**：**逐字**「**request insurance rates from all partner-enabled providers in one flow**」**并**返**回「**comparison id plus calculated rates**」**——**⭐ 即**「**一次**请求**、**多**家**报价**、**带**比价 **id」**的**传输**模式**（**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**是**比价**与**中介**渠**道**系**统**的**典型**接口**形态）**；**③ **同**一**仓库**还**含**服**务**端**实现****——**⭐ 逐字**：**「**This repository also contains the Partner API server (`server/`) — a Node.js HTTP API on https://partner-api.vergelijkdirect.com that runs the same comparison flow server-side: partners send one request and receive a comparison id plus calculated rates.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**客**户端**与**服**务端**同**源」**，**读**者**能**对**照**请**求**与**应**答**两**侧**；**④ **它**的**发布**工程**信**号**可**读****（**61** 个**版本**、**版本**号**带**构**建**标**签 **`-VER-9344.0`**、**周**下载 **236）**——**⭐ 即**它**不**是**新**项**目**，**而**是**有**多**年**迭**代**与**实**际**调**用**的**企业**包**（**⭐ 但**「**有**下载」**不**等于**「**公开**可用」**，**见 ⚠️ 第 **④** 条**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未安装**该**包**、**未**调**用**其 **API**。
e.body:
**Vergelijkdirect Insurance Transmission Client**（npm `@vergelijkdirect/insurance-transmission-client`）**是一个**发**布**在 **npm**、**而**仓**库**在 **Bitbucket** 的**保险**报**价**传**输**客**户端****——**逐字自述**为**「**Partner-facing JavaScript/TypeScript client for the Vergelijkdirect Insurance Transmission API**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**软件**包**注册处**面（**npm）**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-25 npm registry 实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① ⚠️⭐ 它**证明**了**「**包**注册处**可以**绕**过**被**鉴权**挡**住**的**托管**面」****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**该**包**元数据**的 **`repository`** 字段**逐字**为 **`git+https://hennadii-kolesnyk@bitbucket.org/vergelijkdirect/insurance-transmission-client.git`**、**`homepage`** 逐字**为 **`https://bitbucket.org/vergelijkdirect/insurance-transmission-client#readme`****；**⭐ 而**第 **381** 轮**已**记**下 **Bitbucket** 的**全局**搜索**需**鉴权、**该**面**至今**未**探**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**「**注**册处**（**npm／**PyPI）**会**公**开**仓**库**与**主页 **URL」**，**故**当**某**个**平台**的**搜索**索引**被**挡**住**时**，**可以**从**已**发**布**的**包**反**查**那**个**平台**上**的**项目**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**找**资**料**时**若**某**源**站**搜**不**到**，**换**「**谁**发**布**了**包／**谁**被**引**用」**这**条**路**；**⭐ 并**且**本**轮**由**此**看**到 **Bitbucket** 上**确**有**在**用**的**保险**软件**（**⭐ 只**是**本**条**为 **npm** 客**户端**，**本**词条**未**去**克**隆**其 **Bitbucket** 仓库**）**。
**⭐⭐ ② 它**的**领域**动作**逐字**很**具体**（**一**次**请求**、**多**家**报价**、**带**比价 **id）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 逐字**写**「**Use this client to request insurance rates from all partner-enabled providers in one flow, receive**」**（**⭐ 该句在本轮抓取的 README 片段处即为截断，本词条照录至此，不补全**），**README** 首**段**逐字**为**「**Partner-facing JavaScript/TypeScript client for the Vergelijkdirect Insurance Transmission API.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**transmission（**传输）**」**在**荷**兰**保**险**比价**语境**里**指**的**是**「**把**一**个**报价**请求**传**给**多**家**供**应**商**并**收**回**结**果」**的**流**程**，**而**不**是**单**纯**的**文**件**传**输**（**⭐ 与**本站**已**收**的 **[[openinsurance]]** 与 **[[susep-open-insurance]]** 所**在**的**「**开放**保险**数据**交换」**主**题**相**关，**但**不**同**国**别**与**机**制）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**是**「**比价**平台**－**保险**公司」**接**口**的**具**体**形态**，**可**作**渠**道**系**统**设计**的**参照**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 同**一**仓库**还**含**服**务**端**实现**，**因**此**请**求**与**应**答**两**侧**可**对**照****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 逐字**写**「**This repository also contains the Partner API server (`server/`) — a Node.js HTTP API on https://partner-api.vergelijkdirect.com that runs the same comparison flow server-side: partners send one request and receive a comparison id plus calculated rates. The browser client below is unaffected and keeps working as before.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**客**户端**与**服务端**同**源**意味**着**「**同**一**个**比**价**流程」**有**两**种**落**地**（**浏览器**内**与**服务**端**）**，**且**更**新**时**明**确**声**明**旧**客户**端**「**keeps working as before**」**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**是**「**接**口**演**进**时**兼**顾**已**有**集**成**方」**的**文**字**示**范**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 它**的**发布**工程**信**号**可**读**，**但**「**有**下载」**不**等**于**「**公开**可用」****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**元数据**逐字**给出 **61** 个**版本**（**`versions` **61** 项）**、**最新**版本 **`1.3.73-VER-9344.0`**（**⭐ 带 **`-VER-9344.0`** 构**建**标**签，**非**纯**语义**化**版本**号）**、**7** 位**维护**者**、**周**下载量 **236**（**区**间 **`2026-09-15` 至 **`2026-09-21`）**、**依赖**逐字**为 **`moment ^2.29.4`／**`invokable ^1.0.3`／**`isomorphic-fetch ^3.0.0`****；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**它**是**一**个**有**多**年**迭**代**与**实**际**调**用**的**企**业**包**（**首**次**发布 **2023-09-27）**，**而 **236** 次**周**下载**大**多**来**自**其**伙**伴**方**的**内**部**集**成**——**⭐ 故**「**它**在**被**使**用」**与**「**你**可**以**拿**来**用」**是**两**件**事**（**⭐ 其**许**可**为 **ISC**，**但**能**否**接**入**取**决**于**是**否**有**伙**伴**资**格）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**看** npm** 包**时**，**下载**量**只**说明**「**没**被**废**弃」**，**不**说明**「**开放**可**用」**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 元数据**与**窗口****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**末次**修改 **2026-09-24T11:32:12****（**窗口内）**、**首次**发布 **2023-09-27T11:14:07****、**许可**逐字 **`ISC`****、**README** 实测 **12,982** 字符**、**描述**逐字**为 **`Partner-facing JavaScript/TypeScript client for the Vergelijkdirect Insurance Transmission API.`****；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**它**本**轮**进**入**视**野**的**原因**是 **npm** 注**册处**的**最**近**发**布**时**间**进**入**窗口**，**而**不**是**新**项**目**诞**生**（**⭐ 与**第 **379** 轮**记下的**「**注册**日 ≠ **出版**日」**同**类：**⭐ 这**一**次**是**「**最**近**发布** ≠ **新**作品」）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[openinsurance]] 与 **[[susep-open-insurance]] 覆盖**开放**保险**与**巴西**监管**语境**、**[[acord-data-quality-monitor]] 覆盖**行业**数据**标准**的**质量**检查**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**一次**请求**向**多**家**供应**商**取**报价**的**传输**客**户端**（**含**同源**服务端）**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **从**包**注册处**反**查**被**鉴权**挡**住**的**托管**面**；**② **把**「**多**家**报价**一次**请求」**当**渠道**接口**的基本**动作**；**③ **接**口**演**进**时**明**写**「**已**有**集**成**不受**影响」**；**④ **下载**量**只**证明**没**被**废**弃**，**不**证明**开放**可**用**；**⑤ **「**最**近**发布」**≠**「**新**作品」**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装**该 **npm** 包**、**未调**用**其 **API**、**未**访问**其 **`server/`** 服务端**或 **`partner-api.vergelijkdirect.com`**、**未**克**隆**其 **Bitbucket** 仓库**，**故**不**主张**其**功能**可用**性**、**接口**稳定**性或**报价**结果**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**npm registry** 的**包**元数据**（**含 **`versions`／**`time`／**`repository`／**`license`／**`maintainers`** 与 **README** **前**段）**与**npm** 下载**量**接口**，**未读**其**源**码**或**测**试**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **Bitbucket** 仓库**是**否**公**开**可**访**（**⭐ 本**词条**只**据 **npm** 元数据**记**录**其**地址）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**「**伙**伴（**partner）**」**资**格**与**接**入**条**件**（**⭐ 该**包**是**否**对**外**开**放**取**决**于**其**商**业**协**议）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **`partner-api.vergelijkdirect.com`** 是**否**公**开**可**调**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**版**本**号**中 **`-VER-9344.0`** 的**含**义**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**末次**修改 **2026-09-24** 落在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-25）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**；**⭐ 而**其**首**次**发布 **2023-09-27** 说明**它**并**非**新**项目**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-25 所见**；**⚠️ 涉**及**保险**比价**与**渠道**接口**，**⚠️ 不**构成**任何**商**业**、**合**规**或**技术**选型**建议**。

e.title_en: An insurance quotation transmission client published on a package registry while its repository lives on a forge whose search interface is gated: it describes itself as a partner-facing client for a national insurance transmission API, explains that it requests rates from all partner-enabled providers in one flow and returns a comparison identifier plus calculated rates, and notes that the same repository also contains a partner API server that runs the same comparison flow server-side; measured this round it has sixty-one versions, a permissive licence, and a few hundred weekly downloads.

e.summary_en: This is an insurance quotation transmission client published on a package registry while its repository lives on a forge whose search interface is gated. **Measured this round**: the latest version is a build-tagged release under a permissive licence, first published in late 2023 and last modified on the twenty-fourth of September inside the window, with sixty-one versions in total, seven maintainers, and a few hundred weekly downloads in the week before this round; the repository field points at a forge other than the dominant one; and the readme runs to about thirteen thousand characters. **This round theme is the package registry surface.** **Four things are worth reading: it demonstrates that a package registry can route around a gated hosting surface, since the repository field names a forge whose own search interface requires authentication and was left unprobed in the previous round, which means that to find insurance software living on a platform whose search is blocked, one can work backwards from the repository and homepage fields of registry packages, and this round reached an actual project on that platform that way; its domain action is specific, requesting insurance rates from all partner-enabled providers in one flow and returning a comparison identifier plus calculated rates, which is the typical interface shape for comparison and intermediary channel systems; the same repository also contains a server-side implementation of the same comparison flow, so a reader can compare the request and response sides of one design; and its release signals are readable, with sixty-one versions, a version string carrying a build tag, and a few hundred weekly downloads, marking it as an enterprise package with years of iteration and real traffic rather than a new project, although downloads do not prove public usability.** **The package was not installed and its API was not called this round.**
e.summary_hk: **Vergelijkdirect Insurance Transmission Client**（npm `@vergelijkdirect/insurance-transmission-client`）**是一個**發**布**在 **npm**、**而**倉**庫**在 **Bitbucket** 的**保險**報**價**傳**輸**客**戶端****——**逐字自述**為**「**Partner-facing JavaScript/TypeScript client for the Vergelijkdirect Insurance Transmission API**」**。**本次實測**：**⭐ 最新版本逐字 `1.3.73-VER-9344.0`**、**許可逐字 `ISC`**、**首次發布 2023-09-27**、**末次修改 2026-09-24（**窗口內）**、**共 61 個版本**、**維護者 7 人**、**周下載量逐字 236（**2026-09-15 至 2026-09-21）**；**⭐ 倉庫地址逐字為 `bitbucket.org/vergelijkdirect/insurance-transmission-client`**；**⭐ README 實測 12,982 字符**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① ⚠️⭐ **包註冊處可繞過被鑑權擋住的託管面**——**該包 repository 逐字為 `git+https://hennadii-kolesnyk@bitbucket.org/vergelijkdirect/insurance-transmission-client.git`**；**⭐ 即**要找回被搜索索引擋住的平台上的保險軟件**，**可從包註冊處的 repository 與 homepage 字段反查**；**② **領域動作具體**（**逐字**request insurance rates from all partner-enabled providers in one flow**，**並返回 comparison id plus calculated rates**）**；**③ **同倉庫含服務端實現**（**逐字**This repository also contains the Partner API server (server/) — a Node.js HTTP API on https://partner-api.vergelijkdirect.com that runs the same comparison flow server-side**）**；**④ **發布工程信號可讀**（**61 個版本、**版本號帶構建標籤、**周下載 236）**，**但「**有下載」**不等於「**公開可用」**。**⚠️ 本次**未安裝該包、**未調用其 API**。
e.body_en:
This is an insurance quotation transmission client published on a package registry while its repository lives on a forge whose search interface is gated. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the package registry surface.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-25 from the package registry**:
**First, it shows that a package registry can route around a gated hosting surface.** The package metadata gives a repository URL on a forge whose own global search requires authentication and which was left unprobed in the previous round, together with a homepage on the same forge. **Because registries publish repository and homepage URLs, a project living on a platform whose search is blocked can be found by working backwards from published packages, which is a general search technique when one source is inaccessible, and this round did reach an actual project on that platform, though this entry is the registry client itself and the repository was not cloned. It also confirms that the platform hosts insurance software in active use.**
**Second, its domain action is specific, namely one request for rates across many providers returning a comparison identifier and calculated rates.** The readme describes a partner-facing client for a national insurance transmission API and instructs the reader to request insurance rates from all partner-enabled providers in one flow. **In this market context, transmission means the flow that sends one quotation request to many providers and collects the results, rather than mere file transfer, and it belongs to the open insurance data exchange theme already represented on this site, though under a different country and mechanism, which makes it a reference shape for comparison platform to insurer interfaces in channel system design.**
**Third, the same repository also contains a server-side implementation, so request and response sides can be compared.** The readme states that the repository also contains a partner API server, a Node.js HTTP API running the same comparison flow server-side where partners send one request and receive a comparison identifier plus calculated rates, and notes that the browser client is unaffected and keeps working as before. **Having both sides in one source lets a reader compare the request and the response of one design, and the explicit note that existing integrations keep working is a wording pattern worth copying when an interface evolves.**
**Fourth, its release signals are readable, but downloads do not prove public usability.** The metadata gives sixty-one versions, a latest version carrying a build tag rather than a pure semantic version, seven maintainers, a few hundred weekly downloads in the week before this round, and three runtime dependencies. **It is therefore an enterprise package with years of iteration and real traffic rather than a new project, and its few hundred weekly downloads most likely come from partner integrations, so being used and being available to you are two different things: the licence is permissive, but access depends on partner status, and a download count only shows a package has not been abandoned.**
**Fifth, metadata and window status.** The package was last modified on the twenty-fourth of September inside the window, first published in late 2023, licensed permissively, and its readme runs to about thirteen thousand characters. **It entered view because its last publish date falls inside the window rather than because it is new, the same class of distinction as the earlier note that a registration date is not a publication date.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover open insurance and one national regulatory context, and a data quality monitor for an industry data standard, **while this entry supplies the form of a transmission client that requests rates from many providers in one flow together with a same-source server implementation. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: work backwards from package registries when a hosting search is gated; treat one request across many providers as the basic channel interface action; state explicitly that existing integrations remain unaffected when an interface evolves; remember that download counts prove only that a package is not abandoned; and distinguish a recent publish from a new artefact.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed, its API was not called, neither the bundled server nor the partner API host was visited, and the repository was not cloned**, so no claim is made about functional availability, interface stability, or quotation results. **Second, only the registry metadata, including version, time, repository, licence, and maintainer fields plus the opening of the readme, and the download counts endpoint were read**, not the source or tests. **Third, whether the repository is publicly reachable was not verified**, this entry recording only the address from package metadata. **Fourth, the partner qualification and access conditions were not verified**, since whether the package is externally usable depends on a commercial agreement. **Fifth, whether the partner API host is publicly callable was not verified. Sixth, the meaning of the build tag in the version string was not verified. Seventh, the last modification falls inside this round window against a baseline of the twenty-fifth of September, while the first publication in late 2023 shows it is not a new project. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on that date and states plainly that it constitutes no commercial, compliance, or technology selection advice.**

**Vergelijkdirect Insurance Transmission Client**（npm `@vergelijkdirect/insurance-transmission-client`）**是一個**發**布**在 **npm**、**而**倉**庫**在 **Bitbucket** 的**保險**報**價**傳**輸**客**戶端****——**逐字自述**為**「**Partner-facing JavaScript/TypeScript client for the Vergelijkdirect Insurance Transmission API**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**軟件包註冊處面（**npm）**」**。
**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-25 npm registry 實測）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① ⚠️⭐ 包註冊處可繞過被鑑權擋住的託管面**——**repository 字段逐字為 `git+https://hennadii-kolesnyk@bitbucket.org/vergelijkdirect/insurance-transmission-client.git`**、**homepage 逐字為 `https://bitbucket.org/vergelijkdirect/insurance-transmission-client#readme`**；**⭐ 即**當某平台搜索被擋時**，**可從已發布的包反查該平台上的項目**。
**⭐⭐ ② 領域動作具體**——**逐字**Partner-facing JavaScript/TypeScript client for the Vergelijkdirect Insurance Transmission API.** 與 **request insurance rates from all partner-enabled providers in one flow**；**⭐ 即**「**transmission」**在此指一次請求多家的比價流程**，**與 [[openinsurance]]／**[[susep-open-insurance]] 同主題不同國別**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 同倉庫含服務端實現**——**逐字**This repository also contains the Partner API server (server/) — a Node.js HTTP API on https://partner-api.vergelijkdirect.com that runs the same comparison flow server-side: partners send one request and receive a comparison id plus calculated rates. The browser client below is unaffected and keeps working as before.**；**⭐ 即**接口演進時明寫既有集成不受影響**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 發布工程信號可讀，但下載不等於公開可用**——**61 個版本、**最新 `1.3.73-VER-9344.0`（**帶構建標籤）**、**7 位維護者、**周下載 236（**2026-09-15 至 2026-09-21）**、**依賴 moment／**invokable／**isomorphic-fetch**；**⭐ 即**236 次周下載多來自夥伴方內部集成**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 元數據與窗口**——**末次修改 2026-09-24T11:32:12（**窗口內）**、**首次發布 2023-09-27T11:14:07**、**許可 ISC**、**README 實測 12,982 字符**；**⭐ 即**它進入視野是因最近發布時間在窗口內**，**而非新項目誕生**（**與第 379 輪「**註冊日≠**出版日」**同類）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[openinsurance]]、[[susep-open-insurance]]、[[acord-data-quality-monitor]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**以一次請求向多家供應商取報價的傳輸客戶端（**含同源服務端）**」**這一形態**。
**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **從包註冊處反查**；**② **多家報價一次請求**；**③ **明寫既有集成不受影響**；**④ **下載量≠**公開可用**；**⑤ **最近發布≠**新作品**。
**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝該 npm 包、**未調用其 API、**未訪問其 server／** 或 partner-api 服務端、**未克隆其 Bitbucket 倉庫**，**不主張其功能可用性、**接口穩定性或**報價結果**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀 npm registry 的包元資料（**含 versions／**time／**repository／**license／**maintainers 與 README 前段）與下載量接口**，**未讀源碼或測試**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**其 Bitbucket 倉庫是否公開可訪**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其夥伴資格與接入條件**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其 partner-api 是否公開可調**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其版本號中 -VER-9344.0 的含義**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口狀況：**末次修改 2026-09-24 在本輪窗口之內（**基準日 2026-09-25）**；**首次發布 2023-09-27 說明並非新項目**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-25 所見**；**⚠️ 不構成任何商業、**合規或**技術選型建議**。
